_doc: Fixed look-dev viewpoints for environment art (docs/adr/0003). World UE cm (X east, Y south, Z up); rotation = [pitch, yaw], yaw 0 = east, 90 = south. Rendered by tools/ue/run_lookdev.ps1 (-MRLookDev). Add one from inside the game with the console command: MRBookmark <name>. Optional pawn_cm (feet, world cm) and pawn_yaw stand the player there in third person, for sprite look-dev.
